title: 第7章 第一次试镜
slug: 制霸好莱坞全本免费-制霸好莱坞最新章节列表
content_zh:
约翰尼哼了一声，“如果你是说杰西卡的话，放心吧，我可不会自寻死路。”
倒不是说杰西卡这么受不了刺激，只是站在约翰尼的角度考虑，肯定希望两大当家女招待都能尽量在餐厅中做久一些。珍妮这边的进展对于杰西卡来说肯定是个刺激，说不定就会加速她离开好莱坞之星的脚步，对这种攀比心理，珍妮很熟悉，看来约翰尼也不陌生。
确定戴夫收到以后，珍妮没问太多，继续工作，等到轮班结束以后才打给戴夫。
“是CSI。”电话才接起来，戴夫就说，他有些兴奋，“他们需要一个罪犯，对外形和演技有点要求，原来约了克莉丝汀邓斯特，不过无论如何，她现在不能来了。他们得立刻找个替补，这是第二季第一集，一切不容有失，所以会再举行一次试镜。我一个朋友在剧组，我和他刚聊过这事——我推荐了你。”
CSI客串？这是个不错的机会，珍妮精神一振，“戴夫，我真不知道该说什么好。”
“别说，只是个机会而已，你的简历能不能通过初审还得看运气。”戴夫在电话那头呵呵笑，“可惜试镜当天我在纽约没法过来，祝你一切顺利。”
他们又闲谈了几句，珍妮便挂了电话，她深思地望着手机，过了一会才把它收进衣袋里。
她是真没想到戴夫这条线会这么早就给她带来回馈，按她预计，《吸血鬼猎人巴菲》新季开拍以后，会有些无关紧要的小角色需要在每一集开拍之前再行招募，也就是俗话说的一集龙套，会在季前开始试镜的毕竟多数都是有点分量的配角，更多的龙套都是在剧本写完后再现行招募，剧组开拍后，每一集都意味着许多龙套的机会。而戴夫如果没有调职，还是演员副导演，当然也要来洛杉矶配合工作，到那时候，她可以得到一个或者两个客串的机会，也算是让珍妮简这具身体正式入行，在那以后就可以试着寻找一些独立电影的配角，然后看看能不能加入演员工会，并且给自己找个经纪人了。
没想到还没等到巴菲开拍，戴夫就给她带来了一个CSI特殊罪犯的试镜机会，虽然他说能不能进面试得看她的简历，但根据陈贞对演艺圈的了解，有戴夫这个演员副导演推荐，不论如何，一个面试机会她都一定会有的，这种人情后门古今中外概莫能外，只要戴夫的朋友真的把他当朋友看，这点面子还能不给吗？
但是戴夫自己也不知道角色类型，而珍妮虽然对CSI的鼎鼎大名有所耳闻，可她前世对血腥场面不是很喜欢，却偏偏没看过这部剧集，记忆空间里也没有，所以她也只能泛泛地磨练着自己的演技，同时等待着下文。
大概三天后，她收到了试镜电话，对方给了时间地点，又和她说了下试镜的角色要求。即使是珍妮，这时候也有些紧张了，虽然她对演艺圈的一些规矩十分清楚，但前世大学毕业后直接就嫁为人妇，其实也根本就没参加过几次试镜，仅有的几次还都是大学时期和同学们一起过去的，玩票性质更重，这种全部希望都放在一次试镜上的感觉还是第一次经历。
难怪演艺圈从业者心理出问题的比例特别高，要是这种满怀希望去试镜却又没被选上的经历多来几次，心理不失衡才怪。——也难怪杰西卡特别不喜欢谈起自己的试镜过程，别看她在好莱坞之星这么吃得开，收到的小费往往比珍妮还多，但每回试镜失败肯定都意味着被否定，也就意味着对自尊心的一次蹂躏，对比这么明显，她会喜欢谈起来才怪呢。
试镜那天她安排了休息，头天晚上特地睡得很早，算好了时间，掐着点出现在了CBS电视台的试镜部门，报上自己的身份和对方的电话号码，前台小姐在查证后给了她一个出入证，珍妮简就凭着这个出入证进入了人来人往的试镜部门。

content_en:
Johnny snorted, "If you're talking about Jessica, don't worry, I won't seek death."
It's not that Jessica can't stand the excitement, but thinking from Johnny's perspective, she definitely hopes that the two leading waitresses can stay in the restaurant as long as possible. The progress on Jenny's side will definitely be exciting for Jessica, and it may speed up her departure from Hollywood stardom. Jenny is very familiar with this comparison mentality, and it seems Johnny is no stranger to it either.
After making sure that Dave had received it, Jenny continued working without asking too many questions, and waited until the end of the shift before calling Dave.
"It's CSI." As soon as the call was picked up, Dave said, he was a little excited, "They need a criminal who has some requirements on appearance and acting skills. They originally made an appointment with Kristen Dunst, but no matter what, she can't come now. They have to find a replacement immediately. This is the first episode of the second season, nothing can be lost, so there will be another audition. A friend of mine is on the set, and I just talked about this with him - I recommended you."
CSI cameo? This was a good opportunity. Jenny cheered up and said, "Dave, I really don't know what to say."
"Don't tell me, it's just an opportunity. Whether your resume can pass the preliminary review depends on luck." Dave laughed on the other end of the phone. "It's a pity that I can't come over in New York on the day of the audition. I wish you all the best."
They chatted for a few more words, and then Jenny hung up the phone. She looked at the phone thoughtfully, and after a while she put it into her pocket.
She really didn't expect that Dave's line would give her feedback so early. According to her prediction, after the new season of "Buffy the Vampire Slayer" starts filming, there will be some insignificant small roles that need to be recruited before the filming of each episode. That is to say, as the saying goes, an episode's supporting roles will start auditioning before the season. After all, most of the supporting roles will have some weight, and more supporting roles will be recruited after the script is written. After the crew starts filming, each episode will mean many opportunities for supporting roles. And if Dave is not transferred, he will still be an actor's assistant director, and of course he will have to come to Los Angeles to work together. By then, she can get one or two guest roles, which can be regarded as letting Jenny Jane's body officially enter the industry. After that, she can try to find some supporting roles in independent films, and then see if she can join the Screen Actors Guild and find herself an agent.
Unexpectedly, before Buffy started filming, Dave brought her an audition opportunity for CSI Special Criminals. Although he said that whether she could get an interview would depend on her resume, but based on Chen Zhen’s understanding of the showbiz industry and the recommendation of Dave as an actor and assistant director, she would definitely get an interview opportunity no matter what. This kind of favor backdoor is unparalleled in ancient and modern times. As long as Dave’s friends really regard him as a friend, can they not give him this face?
But Dave himself didn’t know the type of role, and although Jenny had heard of the famous CSI, she didn’t like bloody scenes in her previous life, but she hadn’t watched the series and didn’t have it in her memory, so she could only hone her acting skills in general while waiting for the next chapter.
About three days later, she received an audition call. The other party gave her the time and place, and also told her the requirements for the audition role. Even Jenny was a little nervous at this time. Although she was very clear about some rules in the entertainment industry, she got married directly after graduating from college in her previous life. In fact, she had not participated in a few auditions at all. The only few auditions were with her classmates in college. The nature of the show was more serious. This was the first time she had experienced this feeling of putting all her hopes on one audition.
It’s no wonder that the rate of psychological problems among people in the entertainment industry is particularly high. It would be strange if the experience of going to auditions with high hopes but not being selected happens again and again, and the psychological imbalance will not be unbalanced. ——No wonder Jessica doesn’t like talking about her audition process.Even though she enjoys so much in Hollywood Stars and often receives more tips than Jenny, every failed audition definitely means being rejected, which also means a ravage on her self-esteem. The contrast is so obvious, it's strange that she would like to talk about it.
She arranged to rest on the day of the audition. She went to bed very early the night before, calculated the time, and showed up at the audition department of CBS TV station at the right time. She reported her identity and the other party's phone number. After verification, the receptionist gave her a pass. With this pass, Jenny Jane entered the audition department where people came and went.
